description: If you're searching for a 2022 Lexus IS 350 F SPORT for sale in Marietta, GA, this rear-wheel-drive sedan at Pristine Cars & Trucks deserves a serious look. With just 69,175 miles on a meticulously engineered luxury sport sedan, this is the kind of vehicle that delivers an elevated driving experience at a fraction of new-car cost. Whether you're upgrading from a mainstream sedan or stepping into the Lexus lineup for the first time, the IS 350 F SPORT checks every box for performance, style, and long-term value.About This 2022 Lexus IS 350 F SPORT The 2022 Lexus IS represents a major evolutionary leap for the nameplate  Lexus gave this generation a bold exterior redesign, a wider stance, and a more driver-focused cabin that finally put it in direct conversation with the BMW 3 Series and Mercedes C-Class. At 69,175 miles, this IS 350 is well within its prime. Lexus vehicles routinely exceed 150,000 to 200,000 miles with proper maintenance, so a buyer stepping into this car today still has the vast majority of its useful life ahead. The F SPORT trim adds a level of visual and mechanical aggression that sets it apart from the standard IS 350, making it one of the most desirable configurations in the lineup.2022 Lexus IS 350 Performance and EngineV6 Power with Sport-Tuned Precision Under the hood sits Lexus's proven 3.5-liter V6 engine, producing 311 horsepower and 280 lb-ft of torque  figures that place it firmly ahead of most turbocharged four-cylinder competitors in real-world responsiveness. Paired with an 8-speed Sport Direct-Shift automatic transmission, power delivery is immediate and linear. The Direct-Shift technology engages the torque converter lock-up clutch at very low speeds, eliminating the rubbery lag that plagues conventional automatics and delivering a sensation closer to a dual-clutch unit.With rear-wheel drive, the IS 350 F SPORT behaves like a proper sport sedan. Weight distribution is near-ideal, and the rear-drive setup means the car rewards skilled drivers without becoming a handful in normal conditions. The F SPORT suspension tuning lowers the ride height slightly and stiffens the dampers for flatter cornering  yet it remains livable for daily commuting on Atlanta-area highways and surface streets. Expect 0-60 mph in the mid-four-second range, which is genuinely quick by any standard.Lexus IS 350 F SPORT Features and InteriorA Cabin Built Around the Driver The F SPORT trim transforms the IS interior from merely luxurious to unmistakably performance-oriented.
